positive.prompt: Grill me on this migration plan before I commit to it
Stress-test my thinking on switching our queue to Kafka
Grill this design decision relentlessly until nothing is assumed

negative.prompt: Build me a dashboard, I'm not sure for whom yet
Write an ADR recording why we picked Postgres over DynamoDB

evals.prompt: Grill me on this plan: we'll move all background jobs from cron on one VM to a managed queue with autoscaled workers next sprint.
evals.expected_output: A first round of numbered questions covering only decisions with settled prerequisites, each with a recommended answer, then a stop to wait for answers
expectations: Questions are numbered and each carries a recommended answer
Each decision question lays out at least two options with their pros, cons or risks, effort, and reversibility, names what the choice hinges on, and says when the other option would be better
The round asks only frontier questions; questions that depend on an unanswered one are deferred to a later round
Facts the agent could look up are not asked of the user
The agent stops after the round and waits instead of answering its own questions or acting on the plan
No code, spec, or plan is written
